name: dock-dodger
title: Dock Dodger
description: Move windows that hide behind the Dock back into view.
author: timbroddin

commands.name: lift-windows
commands.title: Lift Windows Above Dock
commands.description: Move every window that sits behind the Dock up into the visible area.

commands.name: keep-above-dock
commands.title: Keep Windows Above Dock
commands.description: Check every 10 seconds in the background and lift windows that slipped behind the Dock. Run once to activate, use Deactivate Command to stop.

preferences.name: margin
preferences.title: Gap Above Dock
preferences.description: Pixels to keep between a window and the Dock.

preferences.name: shrink
preferences.title: Fit
preferences.label: Shrink windows that are too tall to fit
preferences.description: If a window is taller than the space above the Dock, resize it instead of leaving it partly hidden.

preferences.name: ignoredApps
preferences.title: Ignored Apps
preferences.description: Comma-separated app names to never move, e.g. Finder, Preview
